versions.changelog: Paid commands take ref (a receipt hash, checked before paying) and credits (spend check credits, fall back to USDC). New free credits command and MCP tool. Orders take a request, source URLs, and fetch_cited.

The description now says where the draft goes (crosscheckapi.com, deleted after the check) and that paying needs a dedicated low-balance wallet key. Clearer wording on confidential text and on reporting failed checks. skillcheck in the MCP server rates skills that do their declared job more accurately.

skillcheck reads large skills: send the whole folder (up to 200 text files); code rules read every file, the review model reads the most important parts first, and model_read in the verdict says what it truncated. Fewer false alarms on vendor API keys and quoted override phrases.
accept can verify the buyer's payment transaction on-chain and bind it to the receipt.
Adds groundcheck: send the sources a draft relies on and each claim is checked against them, with quotes verified in code.
Adds skillcheck: a security review of a skill or MCP server before install, free for files already scanned.
Adds accept: check work another agent or service hands back against the task, before paying for it or passing it on.
Links the public source repo (github.com/maxugc/crosscheck) and shows the live Base mainnet quote in the API reference.
Pays on Base mainnet by default, Base Sepolia for free trials; stricter reviewer.
First release: independent review of agent drafts, paid per check over x402.
